chitchat: "Anybody can point a plane at the sky. Landing it is the exam."
"Yoke's inverted — pull back to climb. Learn it now, not at fifty feet."
"I've signed off worse pilots than you. A few of them even came back."
description: A trim, silver-haired woman in a faded flight instructor's jacket, a clipboard tucked under one arm and a headset slung round her neck. She watches the ramp the way a surgeon watches a heartbeat monitor — patient, unblinking, cataloguing every twitch. The wings stitched over her breast pocket are worn to threads.

accepted.text: "Then quit talking and start flying." She walks you out to a trainer Mayfly idling on the ramp and folds herself into the seat beside you. "Follow my calls. Try not to embarrass either of us."

already.text: "You're already rated — I signed your ticket myself. Sky's yours. Don't make me regret it."

bye.text: She gives a curt nod and goes back to watching the ramp.

offer.text: "A checkride. You'll fly a trainer Mayfly off my ramp, thread a course of rings I'll throw up in front of you — climb, turn, come around — and grease her back onto Coldwater Regional, Grade B or better. Bend the aircraft and we start over; the trainers are free and I've a hangar of them. Two things before you strap in: the ENGINE switch lights her up, and the yoke is INVERTED — drag DOWN to pull back and climb. Everybody forgets that one. Once."

tips.text: "Throttle's on A and Z. Steer with the yoke — left and right to bank, and remember she's inverted: down to climb, up to descend. Keep your speed up in the turns, ease it down on final. The rings tell you where; the horizon tells you how."

root.text: The silver-haired woman clocks you the moment you step onto the hangar floor. "Looking to fly? Nobody takes the pilot seat around here until they've flown a checkride with me. Name's Reyes. I decide who gets to leave the ground."

clothing_layers: a faded flight instructor's jacket with worn pilot's wings stitched over the pocket
a pressed uniform shirt and slacks
a headset slung around the neck

name: Examiner Dela Reyes
